title: Agentic Configuration Reviewer
tagline: Review infrastructure and application configuration before deployment
audience: DevSecOps, platform and cloud engineers, infrastructure-as-code authors, security champions in engineering teams
outcomes: Parse and normalize Terraform plan output and Kubernetes YAML while preserving file, line and resource provenance
Combine deterministic policy rules with AI-assisted context and explanation
Generate minimal remediation diffs and validate them with native tooling
Integrate review results into a pull request as read-only comments that never auto-merge
Build a rule test suite and measure precision, missed cases and noisy alerts
modules: Supported formats, parsers and provenance
Deterministic policy rules
AI explanations in a strict schema
Candidate diffs and native validation
Pull-request integration, read-only by default
Evaluation, developer experience and capstone
capstone: A developer workflow that parses supported configuration files, runs deterministic policy checks, uses AI for context and remediation drafts, validates proposed changes natively, and comments on a pull request without ever merging.

title: Agentic Architecture Reviewer
tagline: Turn system designs into traceable threat models and security recommendations
audience: Security architects, solution architects, application security, platform architects, engineering leads
outcomes: Extract components, data flows, identities, external dependencies and trust boundaries from structured architecture inputs
Represent the system as a graph with provenance and uncertainty
Apply a repeatable threat-modeling method such as STRIDE to modeled components and flows
Generate architecture findings with evidence, assumptions, impact and recommendations
Compare intended design with selected implementation evidence without over-claiming verification
modules: Architecture inputs and a constrained format
The system graph with provenance
Requirements extraction
Method-driven threat generation
Architecture review rules
Evidence-graded findings
Architect review and decision records
Design-to-implementation comparison
Evaluation and capstone
capstone: A tool that ingests structured architecture inputs, builds a provenance-aware system graph, generates a linked threat model, produces evidence-graded findings and records architect decisions, with optional implementation cross-checks that report gaps rather than proof.
